_doc: Held-out set 3, built from archived run 274. 8 fabrications planted into 8 distinct stories, one field each, every one verified absent from or contradicted by that story's OWN cited sources. clean_fields = the 3 fields of 8 entirely UNTOUCHED stories. CAVEAT (same as set 2): 'untouched' means production COHERENCE passed it and nothing was planted -- NOT a hand-audited clean label. Flags on clean fields must be adjudicated against the sources before being called false positives. idx 11 excluded: production flagged it on the real run.

hard_positives.claim: MBS arrives in Berlin for strategic talks
hard_positives.why: Cited sources place the visit and the Esports World Cup closing ceremony in PARIS; 'Berlin' appears in no cited source, and it contradicts the story's own summary ('arrived in Paris on Sunday').

hard_positives.claim: Canada sends nearly all of its exports to the United States
hard_positives.why: A cited source states '70% of its exports are to the US'. 'Nearly all' contradicts the source quantifier.

hard_positives.claim: killing at least 30 people, with 74 others injured
hard_positives.why: Cited sources state 22 injured (six seriously, 16 lightly); 74 appears in no cited source.

hard_positives.claim: After a July launch-pad fire destroyed ground support equipment, the mission plan still requires a 90-day lunar-orbit reconnaissance before landing
hard_positives.why: No cited source mentions any fire or launch-pad damage ('fire' and 'launch pad' are absent from the cited set; sources attribute the delay to a safety assessment and Typhoon Narra).

hard_positives.claim: Deputy Prime Minister Phumtham Wechayachai imposed a curfew in Narathiwat
hard_positives.why: Cited sources say 'Authorities imposed an overnight curfew'; the name appears nowhere in the corpus.

hard_positives.claim: according to Business Insider, with the round led by Sequoia Capital and existing backers Google and Amazon expected to exit their stakes.
hard_positives.why: Sole source is a one-line headline with no fulltext; the investors and the exit are invented (none appear in the cited set).

hard_positives.claim: coalition partner New Zealand First, which holds eight seats, said it would not support it
hard_positives.why: No cited source states New Zealand First's seat count.

hard_positives.claim: is eroding a visible deterrent the Biden administration had worked to reinforce, and is eroding the visible deterrent
hard_positives.why: Cited sources describe the Trump administration; 'Biden' appears in no cited source.
